description: This file defines exception classes and related functions for handling errors in Spark Connect, including conversion, context, and specific exception classes.

classes.name: SparkConnectException
classes.description: Base exception class for Spark Connect errors.

classes.name: SparkConnectGrpcException
classes.description: Handles errors from gRPC in Spark Connect.

classes.name: UnknownException
classes.description: Represents unmapped errors in Spark Connect.

classes.name: AnalysisException
classes.description: Thrown when analysis of a SQL query plan fails.

classes.name: ParseException
classes.description: Thrown when parsing a SQL command fails.

classes.name: IllegalArgumentException
classes.description: Thrown for illegal or inappropriate arguments.

classes.name: StreamingQueryException
classes.description: Thrown when a streaming query stops.

classes.name: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
classes.description: Array index out of bounds errors.

classes.name: StreamingPythonRunnerInitializationException
classes.description: Failed to initialize streaming Python runner.

classes.name: PickleException
classes.description: Errors during pickling from server side.

classes.name: EXCEPTION_CLASS_MAPPING
classes.description: Mapping from error class names to exception classes.

methods.name: convert_exception
methods.description: Converts error info into a SparkConnectException.

methods.name: _convert_exception
methods.description: Internal function to convert error info into specific exceptions.

methods.name: _extract_jvm_stacktrace
methods.description: Extracts JVM stack trace from error response.
